UserSync.title: UserSync
UserSync.description: Stores synchronized settings, bookmarks, custom tasbihs, reading progress, reminders, and journal entries for cloud backup.

userId.description: The unique Firebase Authentication UID of the owner.

prayerSettings.description: User's location and preferred methods for prayer calculations.

bookmarks.description: Saves of favorite Quran passages, supplications, and holy events.

readingProgress.description: Tracking of currently reading sections and completed verses.

/users/{userId}/sync/data.description: Cloud backup of all user customized states.
